brief:
Israeli security cabinet member Gidi Katz warned Hamas against attacking soldiers during commemorations of October 7, the Ma'an news agency reported. Katz stated that any such targeting would provoke a response exceeding all bounds, according to the statement.

The warning comes as Israel marks the anniversary of the October 7 attack. Heightened tensions and security concerns surround the commemoration period.
title: Israel's security chief warns Hamas over targeting soldiers on October 7 anniversary
